title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for paid rate-error credit
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for paid rate-error credit.

## Decision basis

For paid rate-error credit: When the exact incorrect review is approved, subtract reconstructed corrected fee from original net plus cumulative signed corrections, floor at zero and round half up to cents, then negate for the additional credit. Without that completed review the outcome is zero and no posting is authorized; a zero entitlement creates no financial event.

## Hypothetical case

For paid rate-error credit: For a hypothetical approved incorrect review, original net of USD 150, signed prior corrections of negative USD 20, and corrected fee of USD 100 yield an additional credit of negative USD 30. Without the completed review the outcome is zero and no posting is authorized.
